verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own documented Data Access API, published as an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec with pagination, lets you read your errors, projects and organization data programmatically, which is a real export path in an open format (JSON). A community user confirmed this by writing a script to dump exceptions through the API. However, there is no documented bulk or one-click export, and nothing shows that 'all' data is covered, so leaving means scripting your own extraction. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/full-account export feature, evidence that the export covers all data types (events, sessions, performance spans), documented open export formats beyond API JSON, and migration/offboarding guidance.
